method.server: Flask test client with synthetic saved metadata, a seeded ranker and 600-photo groups. No source image files or vision inference. One cold request, median of three warm requests; the separate fifth request collects cProfile samples and is not timed.
method.browser: Headless Chromium with SwiftShader at 1440 x 900. Synthetic 3,600-photo catalogue, six groups of 600; image and atlas cells reuse only the public test library. Synthetic IDs exercise the legacy enhancement fallback. CDP CPU samples and Performance metrics; each window includes an 800 ms settling allowance.
method.limits: Representative local runs, not cross-machine guarantees. API timings exclude HTTP transport; browser timing includes rendering and fixture routing. Startup, discovery, RAW decode, model inference, embedding-based clustering and richly tagged API catalogues are not benchmarked here. Original-pixel and colour parity have separate browser checks.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Expanding one group created every card, image, annotation host and animation at once. Scrolling also triggered catalogue flights.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Keep stable row heights and nearby live rows, preserve look-alike families, selection, drawing and keyboard focus, and exclude scroll-window mounts from flights. Fans occupy the full row and retain readable paper.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Group loading downloaded a second photo catalogue and rebuilt the sea page by page.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Reuse the world catalogue only when its version and group counts match the board; otherwise load the authoritative board. Publish one complete roster.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Every board page repartitioned the whole library and rebuilt group summaries.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Cache a board snapshot by library, cup, group and vote revisions; edits and undo invalidate it.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Every Filter page reassessed all photos.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Reuse admission calculations until a SQLite write from any connection, mode change or age-limit boundary. Preview, Apply and Undo retain their validation.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Colour-field voting blocked the camera thread during motion and group focus.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Run exactly the same colour calculation in an OffscreenCanvas worker, retain the previous surface while it works, discard stale jobs and retain a synchronous fallback.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Every mounted photo fetched its annotations in a separate request.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Batch visible annotation reads, share pending reads and cached edits, and retain the single-photo fallback for a server that predates reloaded scripts.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: The journey HUD built every standing and repeatedly scanned Sweep candidates to choose a thumbnail and display a count.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Read the first standing directly; cache Sweep candidates with database revision checks and defer photo views until the Sweep actually needs them. Crown checks visit real stacks.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Selecting a whole group could force tiny or off-screen selected photos into live DOM.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Keep selected thumbnails as sprites with visible selection marks; only readable or actively handled cards come up live.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Bulk group edits copied a whole-library admission mask per photo, and silently truncated at 500 photos.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Validate against one cup mask and handle the whole selection, up to an explicit 50,000-photo bound. A 1,200-photo move/create and undo test also uses the older 999-variable SQLite limit.

bottlenecksAndChanges.cause: Repeated animation enumeration and element-height reads forced unnecessary style/layout work.
bottlenecksAndChanges.change: Reuse a card’s frozen pose and viewport height; query animation phase only when a bare image becomes paper. Clear activity callbacks when handing the shared sea to another screen.

qualityAndInteractionChecks: GPU and Canvas fallback colour fields match the worker pixel for pixel; late colour jobs and worker failure preserve the final colour.
6,000 GPU prints remain rendered with bounded live cards and image requests, including original pixels at deep zoom.
DPR 1/2 original checkerboards retain measured fine detail against a screen-space reference; fine pixels, temporary failures, zoom-out sampling and late originals are checked.
Expanded group selection and saved strokes survive unmounting and returning; stack fans reserve height, families stay together and phone layouts fit.
Group move/create and undo cover every one of 1,200 selected photos; Filter caches notice writes from either SQLite connection and age boundaries.
Filter, Crown propagation, Stacks merging, tag editing, notes and the full journey browser suites remain functional.

Batched annotation reads deduplicate requests, preserve newer edits, cancel queued reads and reject late replies across libraries; an older server and an individually missing photo preserve the remaining drawings.
remainingCosts: The first admission assessment still evaluates the library. The cache speeds repeated reads without bypassing evidence.
Legacy enhancement sampling and layout/painting of newly visible cards remain visible in browser profiles. They now operate on nearby cards instead of every expanded photo.
Photo discovery, original decoding and model inference need their own image-format and storage-device benchmarks; this pass does not trade their output quality for speed.
